PRIORITY 5: BUILD RELATIONSHIPS TABLE
ESTIMATED TIME: 1-2 days | TARGET: 100-150 relationships
Go to the 'Relationships' tab and document how cells connect to each other.
RELATIONSHIP TYPES:
• part_of: Cell is part of a larger structure (int1DL part_of int-ring-I)
• develops_from: Developmental lineage (int1DL develops_from Ealaad)
• adjacent_to: Spatial neighbors (int1DL adjacent_to int1DR)
• connected_to: Physical connections (neuron connected_to muscle)
• expresses: Gene expression (int1DL expresses vit-2)
• contains: Structures within cell (int1DL contains gut-granules)

PRIORITY 6: MAP FIGURES TABLE
ESTIMATED TIME: 1-2 hours | TARGET: 5-10 key figures
Go to the 'Figures' tab and document which cells appear in which figures.
Figure type is now THREE columns (not the old single "image type"):
• media_type        = what KIND of figure it is:
image, diagram, table, movie, animation, interactive-3d
(REQUIRED for every figure)
• capture_technique = HOW it was imaged, if a microscope was used:
DIC, TEM, SEM, epifluorescent, confocal, AFM
(type N/A if it was drawn or built, not imaged)
• is_composite      = 1 if it overlays channels or stitches images together,
otherwise 0   (this replaces the old "merged" value)
Reminder: type N/A when a field does not apply; leave BLANK only when it
applies but you haven't filled it in yet.
EXAMPLE - a diagram and a fluorescence image (IntFIG1):
figure_id | panel | entity_id    | visibility | media_type | capture_technique | is_composite
IntFIG1   | A     | intestine    | primary    | diagram    | N/A               | 0
IntFIG1   | B     | int1DL       | labeled    | diagram    | N/A               | 0
IntFIG1   | C     | gut-granules | primary    | image      | epifluorescent    | 0
EXAMPLE - a MOVIE (pharynx pumping, filmed under DIC, no sound):
media_type=movie | capture_technique=DIC | is_composite=0
Also fill: media_file, media_format (mp4), duration_seconds, poster_image.
ai_summary must describe what HAPPENS over time, not a single frame.
EXAMPLE - an INTERACTIVE 3D MODEL (nerve ring, reconstructed from TEM):
media_type=interactive-3d | capture_technique=TEM | is_composite=0
Also fill: media_file, media_format (glb), text_alternative (REQUIRED).
Set view_orientation, magnification, scale_bar to N/A (reader controls them).
EXAMPLE - a TABLE:
media_type=table | capture_technique=N/A | is_composite=0
Enter as a real table, not a screenshot. If only an image exists, type its
full contents into text_alternative.
EXAMPLE - an old "MERGED" figure (DIC with fluorescence overlaid):
media_type=image | capture_technique=DIC | is_composite=1
(If a composite has no single technique - e.g. a timeline built from several
papers, like IntFIG3 panel A-main - use capture_technique=N/A, is_composite=1.)
This helps AI answer: 'Show me a movie of pharyngeal pumping' or
Show me figures containing int1DL'.
